sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet profiles and 93 September 23–24 channel briefs screened.
187 X account candidates sampled; 178 returned links; 208 current post records collected. Selected original posts retrieved in full.
Authenticated AlphaGap Feed and signed-in X/Grok reviewed for leads; SubnetRadar, TAO Daily and TAO Media scanned. Primary evidence governs publication.
170 repository paths scanned and refreshed through 10:52 AM ET. Selected code changes inspected.
85 linked Moments screened; no fresh lock/ownership event selected. AI-generated flow interpretations are not treated as evidence of motive.
SN78 primary project and bridge statements, live competition endpoint, SN121 live Scout page, SN8 Pro rules and SN75 migration case study checked.
Market snapshot at 10:52 AM ET. Network allocation distinguished from local miner-weight activation and burn settings.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked; ForeverMoney replay and October 1 SN49 Nepher scheduled broadcast verified from watch-page metadata.
accessGaps: A broad source scan cannot guarantee every announcement is found. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts may be absent.
SN118 burn and SN44 operational recovery remain attributed secondary channel reports; original Discord messages and complete historical state were not independently verified.
SN122 team activation announcement includes pending validator synchronization; the current snapshot still reports zero network allocation. SN78 competition endpoint reports rewards inactive.
SN78 buybacks are team-reported and future purchases remain planned. Base launch verified through both projects; Robinhood market activation not separately verified.
SN75 case study lacked independent customer confirmation. Project benchmarks and activity counts were not independently reproduced or audited.
Repository merges do not prove operator adoption. SN51 server-side API budget enforcement remains pending. SN79 mainnet time is a plan after cutoff.
11 repository paths had access/refresh errors. Sources were observed at different times; repository cutoff is 2026-09-24T14:52:33.656Z.

editorialDecisions.decision: Exclude unrelated StonkFun, generalized price hype, recaps and unsupported partnership claims; preserve older editions.
Base confirmed; 2000TAO planned, 340TAO cumulative team-reported. Reward endpoint still inactive.
Strictly greater than1000alpha; activation pending validator sync; snapshot allocation zero.
Secondary burn report developing; do not equate burn with network allocation or publish unverified misconduct allegations.
No unsupported reversal of prior signed agreement based on moderator summary.
Alpha support merged and README says live; route liquidity not independently tested.
Subnet Summer explicitly permits operator refusal of votes; do not claim trustless execution.
